summary.text: Lisa Demuth, a Republican and Speaker of the Minnesota House of Representatives, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of Minnesota to Amy Klobuchar.
She ran with running mate Ryan Wilson, an attorney and the party's 2022 state auditor nominee, and has represented District 13A in central Minnesota since 2019.

paragraphs.text: Demuth was born in Paynesville, Minnesota, and lives in Cold Spring.
Before entering the Legislature she ran a small business and served 11 years on the ROCORI school board.
Demuth was first elected to the Minnesota House in 2018 and led the House Republican minority in 2023 and 2024, after being elected House Republican leader in 2022.
She was elected Speaker on February 6, 2025, under a power-sharing agreement that ended a DFL boycott, after the Minnesota Supreme Court ruled that her January election as Speaker lacked a quorum.
Her campaign says she was the first Black lawmaker to serve as Speaker.
She received 42.6% of the vote to Amy Klobuchar's 55.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: GOP Minnesota House Speaker Lisa Demuth launches campaign for governor
